context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the library's complex number API, including construction, arithmetic operations, and magnitude calculation. It checks that complex() is used to create complex numbers from re/im components and that results are correctly extracted back to plain objects.

checklist.name: Uses complex() constructor
checklist.description: The implementation uses the library's complex() function to create complex number instances from re/im components rather than implementing complex arithmetic manually.

checklist.name: Uses library arithmetic functions
checklist.description: Operations like addition and multiplication are performed using the library's add() and multiply() functions (or equivalent) on complex instances, not manual formula implementations.

checklist.name: Uses abs() for magnitude
checklist.description: The complexMagnitude function uses the library's abs() function on a complex number to compute the magnitude, returning a plain number.

checklist.name: Handles sqrt of negative numbers
checklist.description: complexSqrt() correctly produces a result with a non-zero imaginary part when given a negative real number, using the library's sqrt() which handles complex outputs.

checklist.name: Returns plain objects
checklist.description: All functions that return complex results extract re and im properties into plain { re, im } JavaScript objects.
